title: A DO INSTEAD NOTHING rule reaches nothing and is not a write bypass

expect.note: the only real finding: RLS is not FORCEd, so the table owner still reads every row — the rules themselves confer nothing

fix: ALTER TABLE c_instead_nothing_rule.messages FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. The view and its rules need no fix — `DO INSTEAD NOTHING` is what a read-only view is *built* from, and this case exists to pin that the write rules stay silent on it.
